feeds.title: TheForce.Net

feeds.title: Sci-Fi Film Fiesta Blog
feeds.description: Through this blog, the author would like to share his enthusiasm for classic / vintage sci-fi films.

TrekMovie.com has grown by bringing on a diverse range of editors and contributors, all of whom are respected experts covering different areas of the Star Trek franchise. trafficked Star Trek news sites and continues to grow.

feeds.title: Science Fiction Classics
feeds.description: Journey into the Golden Age of SciFi at Science Fiction Classics. Immerse yourself in reviews, commentary, and the wonders of science and philosophy with the SFC journal - a treasure trove of engaging content, offering insightful articles, reviews, and in-depth discussions that delve into the vast world of science fiction.

feeds.title: Film Shortage
feeds.description: Film Shortage is an online short film cinema. We feature mind-blowing new shorts every day along with fresh new trailers and filmmaking tips!

feeds.title: This Is Cool
feeds.description: This-Is-Cool is a UK based website dedicated to the love of the visual art of Science Fiction, Fantasy and Horror. Featuring artists, cosplay, photography, book and movie reviews, trailers and video games. If we love it, we'll put it on!

feeds.title: Sci-Fi Bloggers
feeds.description: Covers sci-fi movies, TV shows, books, video games and more! We're an online magazine focused on sci-fi and fantasy entertainment.

feeds.title: 5D. Sci Fi, Fantasy and Horror
feeds.description: A blog that showcases my love of the Sci-Fi/Fantasy & Horror genres. It's full of reviews, interviews, plus the odd occasional musings both on the mainstream and the more obscure fair! Supporting British productions and the independent-minded.

feeds.title: Star Trek Movie Blog
feeds.description: Blog about JJ Abrams' Star Trek 2.0 movies and any other Trek news worth posting about.

feeds.title: J.J. Abrams' Star Wars
feeds.description: This blog covers all things about Star Wars which includes Star Wars News, Features, Spoilers, Reviews And More.

feeds.title: Recursor.TV
feeds.description: Recursor.TV features the best science fiction available on planet earth. Here you can explore a growing database of short films and series created by a new generation of visionaries. Curated by aficionados, Recursor has something for all fans of the genre from time travel to artificial life to alien encounters. Recursor assimilates new content all the time so check back frequently to discover the future reflected.

feeds.title: Sci-fi interfaces
feeds.description: Sci-fi interfaces analyzes the interfaces seen in movies and television show for fun and erudition. Its main author and curator is Chris Noessel. He does this in his 'spare time' so two posts a week is a pretty good pace. All screenshots are property of the studios who produced the show and are used under Fair Use laws.

feeds.title: Star Trek
feeds.description: Trekker first and Science Fiction writier second, now blogging at Star Trek Sci Fi Blog for almost a decade now which presents News, Facts, Stories, TV Show reviews, previews and Trekker Trivia. Analysing the science behind Star Trek explains much of the technological wonders and futuristic mysteries etc to heighten the buzz. We enjoy Star Trek Movies, TOS TNG, TAS, DS9, and many more.

feeds.title: SFFWorld
feeds.description: SFFWorld is one of the Internet's largest and oldest online communities dedicated to the discussion of Science Fiction and Fantasy in print and on screen (TV, Movies, & Video Games).

feeds.title: The 7th Matrix Blog
feeds.description: The 7th Matrix exists to help raise awareness in SF&F fans about the tremendous amount of exceptional independent genre web series and short films available on the web.

feeds.title: SciFiChick
feeds.description: This website contains News, Reviews, Interviews, and Giveaways of the latest sci-fi movies.

feeds.title: Star Trek Reviewed
feeds.description: Fan-Made Star Trek Video and Audio adventures and comedies, live action, animation, and audio.

feeds.title: The Andrew Blog
feeds.description: Andrew Bloom created The Andrew Blog in 2010 as a central location for all of his writing from across the web. Since that time, the site has grown more and more notable as a source for thoughtful takes on everything from film, television, and music, to sports, humor, and current events.

feeds.title: Sci-Fi Talk
feeds.description: They are committed to giving the readers bluntly honest reviews of Science Fiction and Horror. The only time you may see something different is when a book or movie crosses genre lines. They are not the correct outlet if you are seeking features or reviews for works that fall outside of these two genres.

feeds.title: StarWars
feeds.description: Welcome to the official home of Star Wars. Follow along and become entrenched in the franchise through exclusive photos and information, showcasing the heart & soul of the movies.

feeds.title: Alien: Covenant Movie News
feeds.description: Alien: Covenant movie news, trailer, cast and plot info. The sequel to Prometheus directed once again by filmmaker Ridley Scott, Alien: Covenant stars Michael Fassbender and Noomi Rapace.

feeds.title: Wookieepedia
feeds.description: Wookieepedia is the foremost Star Wars encyclopedia in the world, home to some of the most knowledgeable fans you'll ever meet. With wiki articles, Discussions content, and editorial offerings, Wookieepedia is your go-to source for all Star Wars information. It's written entirely by fans, and anyone can contribute - including you!
